name: singlet_annotation_marker_based_cell_assignment
title: Marker-based cell type assignment
description: Assigns each cell to a candidate cell type, or to unknown, using a user-supplied table of positive and negative marker genes per type. The default method, cellassign, fits a marker-constrained negative-binomial mixture on raw counts and returns posterior probabilities; sctype, aucell and module_score are heuristic comparators and scina is a two-state Gaussian comparator. It writes obs/marker_label_<method>, obs/marker_confidence_<method>, obsm/marker_scores_<method> and uns/marker_assign_<method>, and it also writes models/cellassign for the cellassign method. Do not use it without a marker table, or when labels should come from a reference atlas; use reference label transfer for that.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

marker_table.description: Candidate type to marker map: each type lists positive genes and optional negative genes.

negative.description: Negative marker gene symbols; read by sctype only.

method.description: Assignment method. cellassign is the proposed default; the others are published comparators.

layer.description: Layer to read. Null selects counts for cellassign and lognorm for other methods.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for the AddModuleScore control draw and CellAssign initialisation.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

cellassign.description: Options read only when method is cellassign.

min_delta.description: Lower bound on the natural-log marker shift; 2 is the published value.

basis_count.description: Number of dispersion spline basis functions.

shrinkage.description: Shrink marker shifts towards a shared mean on the log scale.

dirichlet_concentration.description: Symmetric Dirichlet concentration on type proportions.

num_runs.description: Independent EM restarts; the best log-likelihood is kept. Published default is 1.

include_other.description: Add an all-zero marker column for cells of no listed type. Published list default is false.

assign_prob.description: Minimum maximum posterior for a called label; otherwise unknown.

covariates.description: obs columns used as model covariates, such as batch.

sctype.description: Options read only when method is sctype.

scaled.description: True means expression is already gene-wise z-scored; false z-scores it first.

uppercase_genes.description: Uppercase gene symbols before matching the marker table.

cluster_key.description: obs column of clusters; when set, clusters below the threshold become unknown.

unknown_fraction.description: Cluster Unknown threshold as a fraction of cluster size, applied to the summed score.

aucell.description: Options read only when method is aucell.

n_up.description: Recovery-curve cutoff in ranked genes; null uses ceil(0.05 G), clipped to [2, G].

scina.description: Options read only when method is scina.

convergence_n.description: Number of recent label vectors compared for stability.

convergence_rate.description: Fraction of cells whose labels must stay stable.

rm_overlap.description: Remove genes shared between signatures before fitting.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: n_cells, unknown_fraction, per_type_counts, method, converged, and log_likelihood where defined.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
